facts.fact: Gauri is Dhanu's wife and Mini's mother; she is practical and broad-handed, and approves Ila's flat knots on Kunal's bandages.
facts.why: needed because the beat gives Gauri apricots and a role in the hut scene without stating her relationship.

facts.fact: Raghu now has eight bound pairs (sixteen men) in the Hollow Moon, arrived in twos and threes by the Kuhl cut; they dug nine holes round the door cairn and more along the east wall.
facts.why: needed because Dhanu's report must detail the eight pairs; extends F485.

facts.fact: Raghu's men drove Hari's nine goats up the Hollow Moon road; Hari was not with them and has not been seen since his hut burned.
facts.why: needed because the beat says they took Hari's goats; Hari's fate stays unknown.

facts.fact: The lower lake huts stand in a fold of shore below the Drum; Ila and Kunal are lodged in the smaller second hut with a plank shelf and one blanket. The flat hearth slab in Dhanu's hut slopes a finger low toward the door and its third corner rocks.
facts.why: needed because the scene is set at the lower huts and the knucklebones cheat depends on the hearth slope.

facts.fact: Dhanu's knucklebones are five polished sheep knuckles, one stained red; Ila's game is the sweep-and-catch version. Dhanu taught Kunal the bones seven winters.
facts.why: needed because the beat requires a knucklebones game.

facts.fact: Ila has written Mini's star name in pencil in the margin of her field book with its bearing, not on any map sheet.
facts.why: needed to reconcile telling Dhanu with Kunal's earlier statement that the star will not go on the map (F466).
